scope: Proposition 7.2 (Shape classification) of the manuscript “Positive Metric Entropy for the Standard Map at Large Parameters” (preprints/Positive-Metric-Entropy-for-the-Standard-Map-at-Large-Parameters-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 146 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 35559ad1965dc13f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 36. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Every nonaffine array in X0 satisfying Theorem 7.1 has one of the following forms: 1. every secant has speed at most cb; 2. there is one exterior ray of exact unit speed, and the complementary closed half-line has all secant speeds at most cb; 3. there are two exterior rays of exact unit speed, separated by a closed interval [a, b] of positive length, and every secant contained in [a, b] has speed at most cb. The second possibility includes either orientation. These descriptions do not assert additivity of distances across the slow part. The three temporal configurations are illustrated in Figure 3.
